fields.statement: A bug request's plan run opens its change set with the intent "Fix <text>", not "Fix: <text>": the display title is the intent's first clause, so the colon made every bug's title "Fix", and two bug plan runs at once shared the branch cs/fix and worktree rhiza.fix (plan runs 01M6GCPN0H and 01M6GCQ7NJ collided on 2026-11-03; one failed at its gate)
fields.wording: the orchestrator's, deciding as the owner's proxy under the owner's standing instruction "act on my behalf" (2026-11-03); assumed, not the owner's words
